topic: A cinematic street-dance hero sequence in a rain-lit underpass with synchronized beats and controlled camera movement
prompt_goal: Create one premium single-video cinematic prompt for Seedance 2 that uses multimodal references: multiple character and style images, motion references from short clips, and one beat guide from audio.
main_subject: An athletic young adult street dancer in a black reflective jacket, graphite cargo pants, and LED-accent sneakers.
setting: A wet urban underpass at night with reflective pavement, practical overhead lights, drifting mist, and bold depth lines.
action: The dancer steps into frame, builds into a sharp rhythmic performance with readable footwork and controlled spins, then lands on a powerful final pose timed to the last beat.
blocking_and_staging: Keep the dancer centered but mobile, with strong floor contact, controlled lateral movement, and a clean final hero pose facing camera.
foreground_midground_background: Foreground mist and rain particles, dancer in the midground, layered tunnel lights and reflective depth in the background.

reference_videos.guidance_focus: Use as the main motion reference for footwork rhythm and camera-follow energy.
Use as the transition and spin reference for controlled circular motion.

reference_audios.guidance_focus: Use as the beat and accent reference for edit rhythm and movement timing.

reference_image_notes: @Image1 and @Image2 define the dancer identity and outfit silhouette, @Image3 defines the wet-lighting treatment, @Image4 defines the underpass layout, and @Image5 locks the sneaker design.
must_include: stable identity, clean footwork, readable spins, reflective wet pavement, strong final pose
avoid: extra limbs, unstable floor contact, muddy motion blur, generic flat staging
